An unread/missing slot is unknown, not false. A visibility interval proves true only if all its possible values are below the threshold; it proves false if all are at least the threshold. Use open and closed endpoints. Current source versions replace superseded ones; incompatible coexisting facts are conflict. Aggregate all registered slots: conflict if any is conflicting; otherwise true if any is true; otherwise false only if every slot is false; else unknown. A TAF is not a neighbor observation. Output JSON strings for truth values, never booleans. Return exactly the requested JSON object, with no prose or markdown. The output must have exactly fact_truth.
